statement: TSMC is reported to be planning wafer price increases of 3-6% for 2027, with AI-specific orders possibly facing larger rises.
why: Foundry wafer pricing is the largest single input cost in an accelerator's bill of materials, so it sets the floor under GPU prices and vendor margins.

impact.mechanism: Higher wafer prices raise accelerator build cost, squeezing chip-vendor gross margin unless passed through to buyers as higher GPU prices.

evidence.excerpt: TSMC locks in 3-6% wafer out price hikes for 2027
TSMC is reportedly planning another wafer foundry price increase

confidence.basis: Secondary trade report, mostly paywalled; corroborating outlets are named inside this one document rather than separately fetched, and the range prevents a single measured value.

dispersion: Stated range 3% to 6%; one outlet suggests AI orders could pay well above that band, unverified from the visible text.
